name: developerknowledge_get_documents
description: Use this tool to retrieve the full content of a single document or up to 20 documents in a single call. The document names should be obtained from either the `parent` field of results from a call to the `search_documents` tool or the `references` field returned by the `answer_query` tool. Set the `names` parameter to a list of document names (`documents/...`), and cite the authoritative source documents used in your final response.

names.description: Required. The names of the documents to retrieve, as returned by the `parent` field of `search_documents` results or the `references` field of `answer_query`. A maximum of 20 documents can be retrieved in one call. The documents are returned in the same order as the `names` in the request. Format: `documents/{uri_without_scheme}` Example: `documents/docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/creating-buckets`
